review.notes: All 6 physical pages were compared against the extracted PDF text with normalized n-gram matching; every patch was verified on rendered pages (word-level garbles at 350 dpi, table cells and section headings at 150-250 dpi, visually read). No code fences and no dropped passages exist in this OCR; both benchmark tables match the PDF values. Source-printed quirks kept unchanged: the doubled period in 'GitHub Offerings..', and the spaced comma after the first 'here' link.
